SideSpeed 0.8.3 is the first release with a second language: the TV app is now in Arabic.

## What's new
- **Arabic on the TV.** Choose it in **About** > **Language**, or pick **Same as device** on a TV set to Arabic. The screens run right to left.
- **A shorter README.** Setup is now short numbered steps.

## Languages
- **TV app:** English and Arabic. About 4% of the Arabic (12 strings) is not translated yet and shows in English.
- **Companion:** English only. No translation has reached 70% yet.

To help translate, see [docs/TRANSLATING.md](https://github.com/DevJardins/SideSpeed/blob/main/docs/TRANSLATING.md).

**After updating:** start the helper again (on Google TV, open SideSpeed; on Fire TV, use the Companion).

## Downloads
**On the TV:** open the Downloader app and enter code **3503400**, or go to `sidespeed.app/tv`. Both always get the latest SideSpeed APK.

**Companion:** open `sidespeed.app/phone` on your phone, or see [sidespeed.app](https://sidespeed.app) for the desktop installers.

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `SideSpeed-0.8.3.apk` (also as `SideSpeed.apk`) | The TV app (Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV with Fire OS) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.3.apk` (also as `SideSpeed-Companion.apk`) | The companion for Android phones |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.3-macos-arm64.dmg` | The companion for macOS (Apple silicon) |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.3-windows-x64.msi` | The companion for Windows |
| `SideSpeed-Companion-0.8.3-linux-amd64.deb` / `-x86_64.rpm` | The companion for Linux |
